use_cases: Select multiple contacts in a contact management interface
Filter and select items in a multi-select dropdown component
Handle selection actions within a contact picker or selector UI
ai_summary: A reusable Button component with CVA (class-variance-authority) variants for multi-select interfaces. Supports 6 visual variants (default, destructive, outline, secondary, ghost, link) and 4 sizes (default, sm, lg, icon). Uses Radix UI Slot for composition patterns and includes standard accessibility features with focus-visible ring states and disabled pointer-events handling.
